message.content: In the conversations, MalfurionStormrage expresses enthusiasm for a gathering once the flowers are settled. He mentions that he agrees with the sentiment of creating a "nice atmosphere" and suggests that a "little community get-together" would be perfect to celebrate the new garden. Additionally, Malfurion proposes setting up a "little area for them" which could involve "some crafts or simple games" to keep things lively. He also suggests having snacks and drinks available, indicating that the gathering would be enjoyable and inclusive. While the exact activities are not specified, Malfurion clearly sees the gathering as a way to celebrate the completed garden and foster community interaction.
